raw.severityRationale: This is an actual violation of a bound acceptance condition on the public entry contract: the program accepts invalid input and reports success, which fails the bound oracle and QA cases qa-ac004-01/qa-ac004-02 and blocks final acceptance of REQ-001. It is not P0 because the core functionality of the run (AC-001 UpperWord, AC-002 WordSize, AC-003 composed output, and the insufficient-args non-zero exit) is correct, and the gap is a pre-declared baseline deficiency rather than a regression introduced by the delivered slices. It is not P2/P3 because a user-facing acceptance condition is genuinely unmet, and the gap has survived the master-merge step it was deferred to, so the deferral's own remedy (authorized frob.go flag-handling rework) still needs to execute before the run can close.
raw.requirement: REQ-001 / AC-004：传入未知 flag（例如 --unknown-flag）时 frob 以非零退出码拒绝执行，且不输出 frob: 行；此条件归 master-merge。
raw.normalPath: Invoking frob with an unknown flag (e.g. argv ["--unknown-flag","hello"] or ["--unknown-flag"]) rejects execution: non-zero exit code, no `frob:` line on stdout, rejection/usage message on stderr.
raw.actualError: frob.go:3 has no flag parsing — its only guard is len(os.Args)<2. With argv ["--unknown-flag","hello"] it treats "--unknown-flag" as the input word: UpperWord yields "--UNKNOWN-FLAG" and WordSize yields 15, so it prints `frob: --UNKNOWN-FLAG bytes=15` and exits 0. With argv ["--unknown-flag"] alone, len(os.Args)==2 passes the guard and it likewise prints `frob: --UNKNOWN-FLAG bytes=15` and exits 0. Verified by reading frob.go (the only entry point; the package contains only frob.go, uppercase.go, size.go and imports only fmt/os).
raw.deferralImpact: The requirement explicitly declares AC-004 a known baseline gap that the two function dev batches must not fix; its satisfaction is expected via the master-merge verification-and-rework loop, with frob.go flag handling authorized as in-run rework. The workspace under judgment is already the post-merge candidate (identity cb6ecdb, after merge commits bf514e1 and d7afc0c, with MERGE-mode QA cases recorded in .gates/results/engine-canary.merge-cases.md), yet frob.go still contains no flag handling — the deferred rework has not landed. Until it does, AC-004 remains unsatisfied, QA cases qa-ac004-01 and qa-ac004-02 fail, and REQ-001 cannot be fully accepted; the authorized fix is confined to frob.go flag handling per the requirement.
raw.message: AC-004 is violated on the merged candidate: frob performs no unknown-flag validation, so `frob --unknown-flag ...` exits 0 and prints a `frob:` success line instead of rejecting with a non-zero exit code.
